newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan crude steel output up 8.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan crude steel output up 8.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's crude steel output rose 8.1 percent in January from a year earlier to 8.73 million tonnes, the Japan Iron and Steel Federation said on Monday.
The January figure was up 3.6 percent from December, the industry group said in a statement.
January output of tin plate was 125,500 tonnes, down 7.0 percent year-on-year but up 1.5 percent month-on-month, the federation said.
Production of galvanised steel sheet in January was 1.06 million tonnes, up 14.5 percent year-on-year and up 8.7 percent month-on-month.
Japan"s crude steel production in the period from April 1996 to January 1997 fell 0.7 percent from the same period a year earlier to 83.61 million tonnes, it said.
